newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Acer says in limited China expansion.
newsitem.headline: Acer says in limited China expansion.

text.p: Taiwan computer giant Acer Inc said on Wednesday it was planning to expand its computer sales in China, but that its group's total mainland investment would not exceed five percent of its annual group sales.

"Acer is negotiating with some partners in China to jointly expand Acer's personal computer sales there, hoping to become the biggest foreign brand in the China market in the 21st century," a company spokeswoman said by telephone.
"But our chairman Stan Shih has said Acer group's total investment in China has a safety limit -- that is, it is not to exceed five percent of our group's annual sales," she said.
Acer group's 1995 sales in China accounted for only 0.3 percent of its total group sales and 1996 China sales are on track to reach 0.5 percent of group revenues.
Acer group's 1995 sales totalled T$151.1 billion, up from T$85.109 billion in 1994.
